subject: Re: Azure Marketplace private plan — Medspire commercial & DPA redlines
messages:
From: Emily Stein <emily.stein@medspire.com>
To: diego.fernandez@redwood.ai
Cc: raj.patel@medspire.com
Date: 2027-04-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Azure private plan — initial procurement packet

Diego,

Thanks for the call this morning. As discussed, Medspire is evaluating an Azure Marketplace private plan to meet our data residency and entitlement requirements for a regulated clinical analytics product. Attached is our procurement request and a short summary of required exhibits (SOC 2 attestation, DPA language, invoice routing).

High level asks:
- Private plan with reserved units (monthly commit) + ability to burst under approved terms
- DPA language confirming data processing within US regions and 90-day deletion for certain logs
- Standard marketplace billing (PO + invoicing to AP@medspire.com)

Can you confirm next steps and an estimated timeline for commercial review? We have a vendor review committee meeting on 2027-04-12 and would like to bring a negotiated term sheet before then.

Attachments: Medspire_Azure_PrivateProcurement_Request.pdf (procurement packet)

Thanks,
Emily Stein
Head of Procurement | Medspire Health
emily.stein@medspire.com
+1 (415) 555-0132
From: diego.fernandez@redwood.ai <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Stein <emily.stein@medspire.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-01T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Azure private plan — initial procurement packet

Emily — thanks for the packet and for outlining the timeline. Looping in Kim (commercial/legal) and Marissa (marketplace ops) to start the internal review.

Quick read: we can support an Azure Marketplace Private Plan with reserved capacity and US-only data residency. A few items we typically need to clarify up front so our legal team can draft a clean counterproposal:
- Exact invoicing flow and PO reference (AP email looks good; please confirm invoice contact and remit-to)
- DPA redlines you need vs our standard DPA (I’ll ask Kim to propose an exception set)
- SLA needs (we offer SLA variations on Dedicated vs Hosted; for Private Plan we can propose a 99.9% uptime SLA with an enterprise support add-on)

Planned next steps:
1) Redwood provides term sheet + initial DPA markups (target: EOD 2027-04-02)
2) Medspire returns redlines (target: 2027-04-05)
3) Final commercial call and DocuSign if both sides aligned (target: week of 2027-04-12)

Attaching: Redwood_PrivatePlan_TermSheet_v1.pdf (term sheet with commercial bands + preliminary DPA excerpts).

If the vendor review committee expects a fully redlined agreement before 4/12 we can accelerate but will need a go/no-go from legal to prioritize.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Sales Director | Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwood.ai
From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@medspire.com>
To: diego.fernandez@redwood.ai, kimberly.park@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-03T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Azure private plan — initial procurement packet

Diego / team — thanks for the quick turnaround. We reviewed the term sheet internally and have a few redlines and clarifying questions. Summary:
- Pricing: Can you confirm whether the reserved commit can be billed monthly vs annual prepay? Medspire prefers monthly commitments tied to PO cycles.
- Data residency: We require explicit contract language that logs containing PHI will be stored only in US regions and deleted after 90 days unless otherwise agreed.
- Audit evidence: Please attach your most recent SOC 2 Type II report or provide SOC 2 coverage dates.
- Marketplace entitlements: We need a clear mapping from Azure SKU to internal entitlements to feed our licensing system.

Attached: Medspire_Redlines_v2.docx (document with inline comments). We also added a suggested alternate clause for the DPA that narrows subprocessors.

If you can return a redlined agreement and confirm billing cadence by EOD 2027-04-04, we can include it in our vendor review packet.

On a process note: please send DocuSign-ready version after commercial alignment; our legal prefers an executed DPA + private plan addendum.

Thanks,
Raj Patel
Senior Procurement Manager | Medspire Health
raj.patel@medspire.com
From: diego.fernandez@redwood.ai <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Stein <emily.stein@medspire.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@medspire.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-04T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Azure private plan — initial procurement packet

Emily / Raj — appreciate the clear redlines. Kim and I reviewed the document with legal this morning and here is our summary and next steps: 

Summary of positions (high level):
- Billing cadence: We can support monthly invoicing against a monthly reserved commit (Net 30), with an annual true-up option. We'll add invoice routing examples to the exhibit.
- DPA / Data residency: We accept the US-region residency requirement for production/PHI logs. Legal proposes the following compromise on deletion: 90-day deletion for application logs containing PHI; operational logs (for platform health) are retained for up to 180 days. We will accept narrowing of subprocessors but need a standard exception list for core cloud infra providers — we'll provide the list in the DPA exhibit.
- SOC 2: Attached is our most recent coverage statement and SOC 2 bundle link in the exhibit.
- SKU mapping: Marissa will produce a SKU-to-entitlement spreadsheet for the marketplace listing; target delivery 2027-04-06.

Attachments: Redwood_PrivatePlan_Redline_v3.docx (redline of your doc with our comments), SOC2_Coverage_Statement_2026.pdf

Action items:
- Diego: finalize commercial counters and send DocuSign-ready term sheet (target: 2027-04-05)
- Marissa: deliver SKU-entitlement mapping (target: 2027-04-06)
- Kim: follow up on any remaining DPA carve-outs and send final DPA exhibit (target: 2027-04-06)

If these dates work, I will ask my counsel to prepare for a combined execution (term sheet + DPA) and we can plan a short alignment call on 2027-04-08 if needed.

DocuSign link (placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/recipient?envelopeId=ABC123DEF456
HubSpot opportunity: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/record/HS-987654

Thanks — Diego
